title: Temperature, Top-k and Top-p Sampling
signature: def sample_token(logits, temperature, top_k, top_p, u) -> tuple
hints: Order matters: temperature, softmax, top-k, renormalize, top-p, renormalize, sample.
Get one ranking with np.argsort(-p, kind='stable'). Stable sorting keeps the lower index first on ties.
For top-p, walk the ranking and keep tokens until the running sum first reaches top_p. The token that crosses the threshold is kept.
Sample with the CDF in index order: the token is the first index whose cumulative probability is greater than u.
